A1.justification: Both PDFs describe PoE-World and provide readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and complete appendices. Corresponding content can be matched despite figure relocation, reflow, and v3's added checklist.

before.justification: v1 reports original Atari agent scores, prediction accuracies, a hard-constraint ablation, and PPO pretraining results in Section 4.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 1–4 and the agent-learning and PPO pretraining curves.

M1.justification: The expert representation, synthesis and weight-optimization procedure, hard constraints, pruning, and hierarchical planner remain unchanged. Expanded explanations in Section 3 describe components already present in v1 and its appendix.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate Pong, Montezuma's Revenge, and their same alternative environments. v3 explicitly describes partial observability and adds environment screenshots without changing the evaluated scenarios.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain Random Agent, PPO, ReAct, and WorldCoder with the same participation. WorldCoder remains the prediction-accuracy comparator, and PPO with versus without world-model pretraining remains unchanged.

E3.justification: The demonstration and interaction budgets, 1000-frame prediction tests, nine-trial ablation, and Appendix A's settings remain unchanged. These include frame skip 3, PPO frame stacking 4, and the same planner controls.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same hard-constraint ablation in Table 4 and qualitative comparison of WorldCoder's and PoE-World's learned programs. No additional ablation, robustness test, or case analysis is introduced.

E5.justification: v3's checklist item 7 newly states that error bars were computed over five seeds. v1 already reports uncertainty and three planner repetitions per initial world model, but does not provide this seed disclosure. This does not establish additional runs, and the error-bar statistic remains unspecified.

E6.justification: Tables 1–4 and the learning curves retain identical results. For example, PoE-World's MR and MR-Alt scores remain 100, and planning successes with hard constraints remain 5/9 and 4/9. The added convergence discussion interprets the retained pretraining curve.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation, conditional-independence assumptions, objectives, and factorizations remain unchanged. Section 3.1 cleans up feature-index notation without changing the mathematics; neither version supplies theoretical proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract and introduction retain the same contributions: compositional programmatic world modeling, efficient Atari learning and generalization, and use of learned models for planning and policy pretraining. Their scientific scope and novelty claims are unchanged.

C2.justification: v3 explicitly interprets PPO pretraining as a warm start whose eventual performance converges with ordinary training. It also characterizes generalization as entity and relational composition and elaborates how fuzzy motion predictions can violate ground-contact constraints. The substantive limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The new checklist supplies an additional anonymous code-access location alongside the retained public links. Appendix A's implementation details, prompts, hyperparameters, hardware, costs, and runtimes are otherwise unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 6 newly connects its compositional generalization to Sehgal et al.'s terminology. The bibliography also adds RoboDreamer, compositional visual generation, and compositional diffusion constraint-solving references, while the existing research positioning remains largely unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 makes localized explanatory edits, integrates the uniform-distribution footnote into the text, and updates acknowledgments and the conference header. It adds a standardized NeurIPS checklist while retaining the scientific section sequence and appendix organization.

P2.justification: The planner illustration moves from v1's appendix Figure 6 to v3's main-text Figure 3. v3 revises the alternative-environment screenshot display, adds a four-environment montage as Figure 7, and adjusts figure placement and captions. Result-table structures and plotted curves are retained.

improvement.justification: v3 improves clarity by bringing the planner illustration into the main text, explaining hard-constraint motivation, and qualifying pretraining as a warm start. The five-seed disclosure modestly improves transparency, although uncertainty reporting remains incompletely defined. These are useful but limited gains; the method and empirical evidence are unchanged.
